column1: # Wave B PR 5 lane 5e round 6: every file removal (unlink, rm) outside the publication door in a file that can reach a page path, reviewed by test/split-layout-writer-census.test.ts.

# A file is in scope when split-layout-writers.tsv classes it door or refuse_before_write, or its code names a page path resolver (resolvePageWriteTarget, source_path, resolveSourceLocalFilePath, itemPagePath, isWriteTargetContained).

# Columns: path, ceiling (removal calls), class (refuse_before_write: names the split-unit predicate or a wrapper of it before it removes a page file; door: the publication door; not_page_path: never removes a page file), reason. A rename over a page path is a write and is reviewed in split-layout-writers.tsv.
